description: Browse the curated catalog of US Treasury Fiscal Data API endpoints. Returns endpoint paths, field names, descriptions, and update cadence for each dataset. Use this tool before treasury_query_dataset to discover the correct endpoint path and field names — a typo in either causes a 400 error from the API. The catalog is a curated subset of the full API — pass any endpoint path directly to treasury_query_dataset to query datasets not listed here. The catalog covers debt, interest rates, exchange rates, revenue/spending, savings bonds, and securities datasets.

category.description: Filter by category. Omit to list all datasets. Options: debt, interest_rates, exchange_rates, revenue_spending, savings_bonds, securities, other.

search.description: Keyword filter against dataset name and description (case-insensitive substring match). Useful for narrowing results when the category is uncertain.

name: treasury_list_datasets

category.description: Broad category: debt, interest_rates, exchange_rates, revenue_spending, savings_bonds, securities, other.

description.description: What this dataset contains and when it is updated.

endpoint.description: Endpoint path to pass to treasury_query_dataset (e.g., "/v2/accounting/od/debt_to_penny"). Include the leading slash.

items.description: One field available on this endpoint.

name.description: Field name as used in fields= and filter= parameters.

type.description: Data type (DATE, CURRENCY, PERCENTAGE, STRING, INTEGER, NUMBER, etc.).

update_cadence.description: How often the data is updated (e.g., "Daily", "Monthly", "Quarterly").

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: List Treasury Fiscal Data Datasets
